stores.name: gallery_photo

fields.name: caption
fields.note: A character field the account holder fills in, with no constraint in the schema on what it holds.

erasure.note: The foreign key to Account uses on_delete=models.CASCADE, so deleting the account row deletes the photo rows.

stores.note: Table of photos, each carrying a foreign key to Account.

stores.name: photo.image

fields.name: image
fields.note: An uploaded image file whose contents the schema does not constrain.

erasure.note: The only receiver that deletes a file is registered with sender=Comment, and Comment has no image field, so no receiver fires for Photo; django_cleanup is not in INSTALLED_APPS and no storage delete is called, so the file stays after the photo row is deleted.

stores.note: Files written under the upload_to prefix photo/images/ by the Photo.image field.

stores.name: gallery_comment
